disposition_reason: Table 1 prints mean ± SD and range of cobalt, lead, nickel, chromium, cadmium, arsenic, zinc and manganese in crude palm oil from a control and two pesticide-cultivated plantations in Cross River State.

study.design: Plantation survey of crude palm oil collected monthly after milling, pesticide-cultivated vs control plantation, with risk assessment
study.origin: three oil palm plantations, Cross River State, Nigeria (Akpabuyo control; Akamkpa and Biase pesticide-cultivated)
study.method: 0.5 g oil emulsified in propan-2-ol with HCl; ICP-OES
study.qa: NIST-traceable single-element standards; no CRM, recovery or LOD reported
